## Specific task description

Task instruction: Use the right arm to place the remotecontrol with a curved shape on the compact black hollow displaystand.

Task description: Use the right arm to place the curved remote with colored buttons on the right side of the table onto the small black hollow display stand near the middle front of the image.

Success criteria: The remote control is on the display stand, with the horizontal positions of the remote and stand close in both the left-right and front-back directions. Both grippers are open.

## Execution tips

- Prefer straight middle sections of the remote's side casing that fit the pads, avoiding raised buttons and curved, narrowed ends. Open slightly wider than the selected width to reduce slipping.
- Before closing, confirm that both fingers enclose opposite sides of the housing rather than merely overlapping in the image, avoiding fingertip contact only with the upper edge and pushing the remote away.
- If reorienting, turn it in an open space above the display stand's top with clearance, keeping the remote's long axis aligned as much as possible with the longer direction of the top to reduce end collisions and overhang.
- Lower slightly during placement and release only after confirming that the bottom of the remote is supported by the stand. Leave room for the fingertips to withdraw, avoiding pressing or moving the lightweight stand.
